chapter: C.L. Burke and Kid Ory years
title: Working for the Board of Education
summary: After Burke's band broke up he worked twenty-one years for the Los Angeles school board.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: After we left Curtis, C.L.'s band broke up and I went to work for the board of education.
Correct; I stayed with them twenty-one years.
But you also did some playing then though.
Well yes, after I started working with Ory, because it was about eight months after I left C.L. before I started with Ory.
you worked for L.A. Unified Schools?
And then reactivated your music with Kid Ory?
